name: Fusarium Wilt of Banana
description: A vascular wilt disease caused by Fusarium oxysporum affecting banana plants. The fungus invades the vascular system, blocking water transport and causing wilting and eventual plant death.
symptoms: Yellowing of lower leaves progressing inward
Leaf petioles buckling and leaves collapsing
Progressive wilting from older to younger leaves
causes: Fusarium oxysporum f. sp. cubense fungus
Contaminated tools, water, and soil movement
prevention: Avoid planting in areas with history of Fusarium wilt
